biggest_catch: You're limited to just 3 referrals per person ($75 total), and the friend must fund an active checking account ($300 deposited + 5 debit transactions) and keep it active 30 days before either of you is paid.
catches: Limit 3 referrals per person — maximum $75 in referral bonuses per referrer.
Referred member must open a savings account ($5 minimum) and an active checking account: at least $300 deposited and at least five debit card transactions posted.
Bonus posts only after the account has been active for at least 30 days.
Both referring and referred members must be 18 or older; referred member must be new and meet membership and checking qualifications.
Offer cannot be combined with other offers; AAC Credit Union can cancel the offer at any time.

steps: Stop into an AAC Credit Union branch to start referring.
Refer a friend or family member to join AAC Credit Union.
Your friend opens a savings account ($5 minimum) and an active checking account: at least $300 deposited and at least five debit card transactions posted.
After the account has been active for at least 30 days, AAC deposits $25 into your account and $25 into your friend's account (limit 3 referrals per person).
timing: Bonus posts after the referred member's account has been active for at least 30 days.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus posts after the referred member's account has been active for at least 30 days. Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
